questions.question: The Arameans said the LORD was only a god of the hills. What did the LORD promise King Ahab in response?

answers.text: He would hand the great Aramean army to Ahab
He would let the Arameans win on the plains
He would send a storm to scatter both armies

questions.question: After Israel defeated Aram, King Ahab met the beaten King Ben-hadad. What did Ahab do with him?

answers.text: Made a treaty and sent him away
Kept him as a prisoner in Samaria
Handed him over to the man of God

questions.question: After taking off his disguise, a prophet gave King Ahab of Israel a word from the LORD. What had Ahab let slip from his hand?

answers.text: The man God had devoted to destruction
The cities Aram took from his father
The silver his army won in battle

questions.question: After the armies of Israel and Aram camped facing each other for days, Israel struck down the Arameans on the seventh day. True or false?
